t: The Titan TTB1178GHT is a robust corded hedge trimmer, engineered for efficient hedge cutting and garden maintenance. Its powerful 550W motor and 50cm laser-cut blades deliver clean, precise results, making it ideal for professional landscapers and keen gardeners maintaining various hedge types. With a 20mm cutting capacity, it effortlessly tackles thicker branches, while the blade tip protector enhances durability and safety. The 2.94kg weight and anti-vibration system ensure comfortable operation during extended use, supported by a generous 10m cable for ample reach across garden spaces.
b: Laser Cut Blades: For Optimum & Precise Cutting Performance
